data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a public-stage defense and security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský, with €44M+ in orderbook backing. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 23 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median methodology proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. Of the 23 Defense & Security peers identified, only 1 operates at the same stage as Primoco, with zero adjacent-stage and zero similar-tier peers meeting triangulation thresholds. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial distortion given the concentrated stage distribution and valuation variance within defense technology. Consequently, no defensible point estimate emerges from multiples-based approaches.

The analysis supports only a wide indicative range anchored to the orderbook foundation (€44M+ committed revenue) and calibrated against the public comp set (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), though direct multiples remain unreliable. Key uncertainties include: revenue recognition timing and margin profile relative to peers, execution risk on orderbook conversion, and stage-specific discount to the private cohort. A more precise valuation would require access to comparable company financials (revenue, EBITDA) and forward contract visibility. Current data permits directional assessment only.
